mapper.select: SELECT id, outcome, chest_radiograph_code AS chestXRayCode FROM tb_screen_chest_radiograph WHERE person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY screen_time DESC LiMIT 1
SELECT remark, outcome FROM `tb_screen_chest_radiograph` WHERE person_id = 21 AND screen_order = 1 LIMIT 1
select screen_order,screen_time,outcome from tb_screen_chest_radiograph where person_id=#{personId} order by screen_order and type=1
SELECT ifnull(count(DISTINCT person_id),0) num FROM tb_screen_chest_radiograph WHERE YEAR(screen_time) = #{year} and screen_type=#{screenType}
SELECT ifnull(count(DISTINCT person_id),0) num FROM tb_screen_chest_radiograph WHERE YEAR(screen_time) = #{year} and MONTH(screen_time)=#{month} and screen_type=#{screenType}
SELECT ifnull(count(DISTINCT person_id),0) num FROM tb_screen_chest_radiograph WHERE DATE (screen_time) = #{curDay} and screen_type=#{screenType}
